_doc: The judgement over the probes' leads, read by console/dev-status/engine_health.py. Key: "<probe id>/<item id>" (the page's address bar shows it after the #, URL-decoded). Value: {"status": "confirmed" | "accepted" | "disproved" | "fixed", "note": "one sentence", "ticket": "KLANG-nnnnn"}. confirmed is red, accepted is grey, disproved and fixed are green. Keys that start with _ are ignored. Filled by the audit of KLANG-00420 and by the fixes after it.

stage-probe/katalyst/reverb/default (wet.note: The documented ANTI_DENORMAL bias (audio-constraints); the audit found it does not keep an engine alive (layer 9).

stage-probe/katalyst/duck/cyl=1 depth=.8.note: L7b-01, fixed in KLANG-00425: a NaN level reads as one sample of full ducking and never enters the state; the probe row now equals the infinity row.

stage-probe/katalyst/duck/cyl=1 depth=1.note: L7b-01, fixed in KLANG-00425: a NaN level reads as one sample of full ducking and never enters the state; the probe row now equals the infinity row.

stage-probe/ignitor/highpass/freq=1000 a.note: L4-01, accepted by the maintainer (2026-11-11): the saturating filter holds a huge state only after a transient 60 to 80 dB over full scale; in the run of 2026-11-11 the 1e30 row still ends at a DC of 5.86e10.

stage-probe/ignitor/bandpass/freq=23999.note: L4-01, accepted by the maintainer (2026-11-11): the saturating filter holds a huge state only after a transient 60 to 80 dB over full scale; in the run of 2026-11-11 since the cutoff clamp moved to 0.49 fs (L4-10) this row decays after the 1e30 sample (under 1e-5 after 9.2 s).

clicks/katalyst/limiter (lookahead 5 ms).note: L7a-04, accepted and documented in KLANG-00428 (audio/ref/katalyst.md, knob-glide.md): with an authored lookahead the gain computer knobs do not glide; kink 5.12, burst -69.8 dB, unchanged.
